notes: The Item 7 targeted excerpt was empty, so no MD&A paragraphs matched the theme terms. Tuition reimbursement and financial education appear in a single benefits sentence of about 75 words; they were not recorded separately because the sentence exceeds the quote length, and they would be employee development under the same Community cap anyway. Year-round safety training for employees and contractors is operational and compliance training and was not scored. The filing points to the 2025 Valero Report on Guiding Principles for community and employee disclosures but gives no specific community activities, so Cross-cultural (insufficient) triggers the automated second look; Community was marked sufficient because the filing describes employee training. Caregiver support networks and an on-site child care center are employee benefits, not cross-cultural practices. The planned idling of the Benicia Refinery by April 2026 does not affect any theme. 'Foundation of respect' and 'reward innovation' are traps and were not scored.
